title: Megurine Luka — Growing Unease〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Then, we'll try looking where we can.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Let us know if you learn anything, okay?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We're going to find her no matter what...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Miku, KAITO...
Please, help her...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We will...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO said they're gonna find her no matter what, but do you really think they will...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I can't say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Me neither. We still don't know why her phone broke in the first place.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What do you think happened...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well, if MEIKO's correct, then something happened which caused her phone to break. Or it's simply run out of battery.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Still, that doesn't give us an explanation as to what actually happened...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which lies at the crux of all this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hopefully, it simply slipped her mind that she needed to charge her phone...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Would Mafuyu forget to do something like that...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, I doubt it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: With her computer gone, her phone is currently the only way she can contact Kanade and the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So... There's another party at play?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Her mother already took away her computer, so she could have tried to also take her phone away...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-Isn't there anything we can do...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: All we can do is wait...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
KAITO...!
H-How's Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you guys manage to reach her phone...?!

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Quiet.
Let me start from the beginning.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We finally managed to reach her phone, and Miku's still with her...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did you learn why you couldn't initially?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Her phone got wet, which caused it to break...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Her mom tried to take it away from her, she resisted and it fell into her aquarium.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So she really almost had it taken away...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Wait, so...
How's Mafuyu doing...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Isn't it obvious? She's been pushed into a corner...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: However, because her mom went so far, she's made her decision to tell her how she really feels.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What...?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Kanade and the others said that she was terrified of the thought of telling her mom how she really feels...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(But still...
Them and SEKAI both act as places of refuge.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (Having her phone taken away would mean she'd have nowhere to go. Nowhere to run...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I want to tell her that it's okay to run...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Or shout, “Run!”
“It's okay to run away from this place!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that there's a safe place where you can run to...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (There's also Mizuki's suggestion...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, you're going back now...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes. We need to see this through until the end.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Please let us know if you learn anything new.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: We will...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, let's all do what we need to do right now.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: What we need to do?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: We need to tell Kanade and the others what we've just learned. I'm sure they're very worried.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Exactly. Let's split up and go tell them.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They need to know what's going on with Mafuyu, including how she's about to tell her mom her true feelings.
